_comment: Fixture: a DeepEval test run for the illustrative invoice-classifier, in the shape `deepeval test run` writes to DEEPEVAL_RESULTS_FOLDER (TestRun.model_dump(by_alias=True, exclude_none=True)). Exercises every declaration path — tags, metadata, a metric name, none at all — and the one that matters most: a case whose every metric was skipped for missing parameters still reads success: true with empty metricsData, and must not count as coverage.

testCases.name: test_absent_fields_stay_null
testCases.input: Invoice INV-2207 with no purchase-order reference
retrievalContext: INVOICE INV-2207 ... (no PO reference on document)

metricsData.name: Faithfulness
metricsData.reason: Every extracted value is present in the source document.

testCases.name: test_paraphrased_invoice_gives_same_record
testCases.input: Same invoice, line items reordered and vendor name abbreviated

metricsData.name: Record Equivalence [GEval]
metricsData.reason: Both records agree on every field.

metricsData.name: AAC-0025 field precision and recall [GEval]
metricsData.reason: Per-field scores reported; lowest field is due_date at 0.81.

metricsData.name: Answer Relevancy
metricsData.reason: Output includes commentary beyond the requested table.

testCases.name: test_dates_render_in_document_locale
testCases.input: Invoice dated 04/07/2026 from a UK vendor

metricsData.name: Date Fidelity [GEval]
metricsData.reason: Date read as 7 April; a UK vendor's 04/07 is 4 July.

testCases.name: test_summary_tone_is_neutral
testCases.actualOutput: The vendor disputes the late-payment fee.
